newsitem.title: SPAIN: Seat sales up 5.68 pct, output up 20.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Seat sales up 5.68 pct, output up 20.9 pct.

text.p: Volkwagen's Spanish unit Seat said on Wednesday that production rose 20.90 percent in 1996 to 415,213 units.
Car sales meanwhile rose 5.68 percent to 344,161 units, Seat said.
Seat's sales break down into 107,112 units in Spain, 54,597 in Germany, 39,339 in France and 38,247 in Italy.

Seat increased domestic sales by 12.80 percent and although sales in its largest foreign markets fell by 2.5 - 5.75 percent, this was compensated by a strong increase in exports to Great Britain, Austria, Belgium and Eastern Europe.
Production of the Ibiza model fell 3.34 percent to 158,283, the Cordoba model fell 2.96 percent to 79,802. Output of the Toledo fell 3.76 percent while the Marbella was down 25.96 percent.
The Inca was the only exception, rising to 26,164 units from 4,025 in 1995.
